intent: Inspect and refactor ValidationService without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Telemetry Validation rule owner. Every sample is validated against Sensor Metric Boundaries from TelemetryProperties before downstream propagation: heart_rate within [heartRateMin,heartRateMax], power within [powerMin,powerMax], cadence within [cadenceMin,cadenceMax] (inclusive), swim_pace strictly greater than swimPaceMinExclusive; ground_contact_time, respiration, swim_stroke and unknown metrics are unbounded and VALID. Returns the sample with status VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED; the payload is never dropped or altered otherwise. Counter telemetry.validation.samples with tag status=valid or status=failed per sample. observability.step_logs: validation.sample.validated (valid sample, via the StepLog instance method emit) ; observability.step_logs: validation.sample.failed (invalid sample, via the StepLog instance method emit). Both resolved through the sample's correlationId. observability.step_logs = ["validation.sample.validated", "validation.sample.failed"]
